description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minFDE20 for five different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio", has a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 with a tick label interval of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE20", also has a linear scale, spanning from 19 to 23 with a tick label interval of 1. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different method: TrajICL (blue, solid line, circle markers), Head Tuning (orange, solid line, circle markers), FT (green, solid line, circle markers), LoRA 16 (red, solid line, circle markers), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line, circle markers). TrajICL starts at approximately 20.3 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to around 18.3 at a ratio of 1.0. Head Tuning begins at about 22.9 and remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 22.8. FT starts at around 22.4, decreases to about 20.9 at a ratio of 0.9, and then slightly increases to 21.1. LoRA 16 begins at approximately 22.9 and decreases to around 22.1. LoRA 64 starts at about 22.9 and decreases to approximately 22.2.
